caption_metadata:
8,061 likes, 608 comments - deepigoyal on October 9, 2026: "In FY2026, 31 lakh Indians chose to earn through Zomato and Blinkit as delivery partners. That’s 57% more than the previous year.

Behind every one of these numbers is a person with interests and ambitions. A student balancing classes, an entrepreneur building something of their own, a dancer pursuing their passion, and a parent juggling work and family.

We co-created this song with Amit Trivedi to celebrate our delivery partners, their many pursuits, and the journeys they’re on.

We’re proud to be a part of each and every one of them.".
